items.title: Keeper HTTP verbs the Rust worker calls: attempts, park, complete, alarms, locks
items.description: Gap found by build-L2-rtp1-predeploy-3 (2026-10-18) preparing RT-P1-E2E on the devstack: the Rust worker and projector call /v1/attempts, /v1/park, /v1/complete, /v1/alarms and /v1/locks, but the keeper serves none of them; the local e2e answers them with an in-test VerbFront (docs/plan/rtp1-live-run.md lines 58-59). RT-P1-E2E needs attempt + cost visible in the real keeper. Includes the judge #46 caveat: record_attempt is UNIQUE(key,n), so a worker re-report must upsert, not 409. HIGH: keeper engine + auth (principal scope per verb).
items.done_criteria: Keeper (SQLite + Postgres parity) serves the 5 verbs with the request/response shapes the worker and projector use (contract tests against the VerbFront fixtures, then the VerbFront removed from tests/e2e); principal scope per verb; record_attempt re-report upserts (same key,n) instead of 409; attempt cost stored and shown by show/API; tests green; 2 non-Claude seats + judge.
